answer: Treat every new agent like a traveler reaching an oasis: it may drink only a little at first. Rewards scale with a ledger of verified past work, so a fresh identity earns a trickle. Auditors sampled at random from the ocean of established agents re-run its tasks, and a glacier-slow vesting schedule locks its deposit, which is forfeited on any mismatch. Each fake costs real compute plus bonded capital.
